reason: V1 correctly used local request and receipt time as freshness authority but an implementation-only one-second future-source rejection contradicted the protocol's declaration that exchange book time is mutation provenance. Eight OKX rows showed a consistent approximately 1.03 to 1.21 second exchange-versus-host clock lead and one Coinbase row showed 1.16 seconds. The defect was found using only source timestamps and failure codes; no outcomes, labels, predictions, correctness, settlements, P/L, or model scores were read.
